reason: Independent customer-style module: an import-free root package containing `"Hello, " + name + "!"` makes `go tool orchestrion go build` panic with 'assignment to entry in nil map' at pinned Orchestrion oncompile.go:195 on Go 1.26.6 and 1.27.0; the plain build works, and a control with one import weaves (Concat3 linked) and runs correctly. Root cause: importcfg.parse allocates PackageFile lazily (importcfg.go:79-82) and OnCompile writes to it unconditionally (oncompile.go:195). The Orchestrion bug is pre-existing, and dd-iast-go's root-scoped operator aspects make it reachable. Same root cause as hooks-yml-operators-F3.
